changelog: v1.3.1 — ChatGPT chats are deleted, not just closed: every chat the extension opens is recorded on the server the moment it opens and deleted from your ChatGPT account as soon as it is no longer needed — job applied / skipped / reported, a failed or re-written CV, a browser closed mid-write, 2 hours unused, or Disconnect (which deletes every chat it kept; the CVs and answers stay). Deleting carries on in the background after Disconnect. The panel shows how many chats are waiting to be deleted.
